claim: Evidence objects carry identity, provenance, context, dependency and permission metadata
allowed_wording: We define evidence as an executable governed object
forbidden_wording: Every metric is independent clinical evidence

claim: Exact duplicate evidence does not increase support
required_evidence: canonical identity resolution; source-group aggregation; duplicate injection tests
allowed_wording: The architecture is designed for duplicate idempotence
forbidden_wording: The current production system is duplicate-proof

claim: Revoking a source removes all active downstream support
required_evidence: complete dependency graph; revocation closure; incremental versus full replay
allowed_wording: Revocation closure is a required system invariant
forbidden_wording: All real pipeline dependencies have been proven complete

claim: QC and model-only evidence cannot become clinician-facing evidence
required_evidence: permission propagation; adversarial rename and Agent bypass tests
allowed_wording: Permission non-escalation is enforced by the governance specification
forbidden_wording: The Agent can never make an unsupported clinical claim

required_evidence: paired nuisance perturbation study with fixed model and facts
allowed_wording: We test whether governance reduces sensitivity to irrelevant changes

required_evidence: nested model comparison; external datasets; confidence intervals; calibration
allowed_wording: Accuracy is evaluated independently from governance integrity

claim: The governed trace is faithful to actual system execution
required_evidence: production event graph; replay; intervention; stale-node audit
allowed_wording: Trace faithfulness will be evaluated against execution logs
forbidden_wording: The diagram reveals the model's true reasoning

claim: The LLM internally follows the evidence graph
required_evidence: open-weight access; activation intervention; causal tracing
allowed_wording: Closed models support only behavioral and interface-level tests
forbidden_wording: The LLM chain of thought proves internal evidence use

claim: A compact evidence set is non-inferior to the full set
required_evidence: nested group selection; external non-inferiority test; calibration and coverage
allowed_wording: We evaluate whether a compact governed set retains performance
forbidden_wording: The current effective rank proves that only a fixed number of features is needed

claim: All evidence should be mutually orthogonal
allowed_wording: Exact duplication should be removed and remaining dependence made explicit
forbidden_wording: All clinically useful measurements must be statistically independent

claim: Random train-test splitting proves the foundation model has never seen the dataset
required_evidence: temporal or private data; contamination probes; model provenance
allowed_wording: Local splitting controls project-level fitting leakage only
forbidden_wording: The test data are completely unseen by the foundation model

claim: Governance supports cross-language and cross-task generalization
allowed_wording: We test whether governance effects transfer across contexts

claim: The current pilot shows feature count is not effective evidence dimensionality
required_evidence: reproducible structure audit on current feature tables
allowed_wording: Current tables show exact relations and lower effective dimensionality
forbidden_wording: The pilot identifies the clinically optimal feature set

claim: Proof generation produces a mathematical proof of AD diagnosis
allowed_wording: Proof generation creates integrity records, replayable execution and empirical support
forbidden_wording: The system proves that a patient has AD

claim: Clinical knowledge or a supervised probability is an additional independent patient observation
allowed_wording: Knowledge interprets evidence and model probability is a candidate prediction
forbidden_wording: The Agent receives three independent votes from evidence, knowledge and the supervised probability
